notices.trigger: Door-to-door sale: the seller personally solicits (including at the buyer's invitation), price $25 or more, agreement made away from the seller's place of business; only a visit to repair or maintain the buyer's personal property is excepted, and anything extra sold on that visit is covered
notices.format: Statement near the signature in 10 point bold; oral notice also required
notices.support: Remodeling, flooring, pools and hardscape sold at the home are door to door sales.
notices.summary_row: Statement beside the buyer's signature (10 point bold); oral notice
notices.block: 1. SDCL 37-24-5.3 (statement in the contract; oral notice)
notices.quote_note: The statute puts the statement inside quotation marks after "in substantially the following form:"; the markers sit inside the quotes, so the quotation marks and the closing ";" are excluded.

notices.title: NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form, in duplicate
notices.trigger: Door-to-door sale: the seller personally solicits (including at the buyer's invitation), price $25 or more, agreement made away from the seller's place of business
notices.format: Completed form in duplicate, attached to the contract and easily detachable, ten point bold, all capitals
notices.support: The form is all capitals in the statute and allows "AN ELECTRONIC NOTICE" of cancellation.
notices.summary_row: NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form, in duplicate, 10 point bold, all capitals
notices.quote_note: No quotation marks around the form itself (only around the caption NOTICE OF CANCELLATION in the lead-in, which is outside the cut); the cut starts at the form caption line and ends at the buyer signature caption. Item (2), the seller duty to complete both copies, is excluded.
blanks: __________ (Date) (deadline, not earlier than the third business day)

changes.new: Three business days; only a visit to repair or maintain the buyer's personal property is excepted
changes.support: The repair exception is for the buyer's "personal property" only

changes.new: Optional pre-suit defect clause (21-1-16, 30 days); the 30 day rule binds the home owner by statute with or without contract wording
changes.support: The 21-1-16 clause is optional: the 30 day rule applies by statute with or without contract language.

changes.new: Excise tax license line only if the contractor uses one (no statute found that makes it a contract print item); copy the customer can store or print
changes.support: no statute was found in the first pass that makes it a contract print item

unsure: SD-cancel-form: SDCL 37-24-5.2(2) takes out a transaction in which the buyer has a federal right of rescission (credit sales); the builder cannot tell that, so the form is printed for every home sale. Whether the form should print on a financed home sale is for a lawyer.

SD-cancel-form: the lead-in line '(enter date of transaction)' then '(Date)' at the top of the form is printed exactly as the statute shows it; it reads like an instruction to the seller, and I kept it because it is inside the form.
SD-cancel-form: SDCL 37-24-5.2(2) excludes a transaction where the buyer has a federal right of rescission; the builder cannot tell that, so the form prints on every home sale.
